description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
2-layer pointer circuit, no LayerNorm: Gaussian look-back heads, ReLU field-end tags, month base-27 bumps, tangent-line digit head.
As ptr_v1 with the 19xx detector requiring all four look-back digits (fixes mm/d0/yy false century).
Tag units rewritten as defaults+overrides: run-end=day, 4-digit=year, slash1/dot=month, padding=weak year/day. Fewer ReLUs and flags used.
Dropped unused stream dims; '=' marker shared with step K0; century is a single 19xx bit read with two scales. d_model 36.
ptr_v4 with the unused second-layer MLP removed: parse attention + MLP, then fetch attention only.
Only 3 look-back heads: the year's hundreds digit (9 or 0) alone gives the century, thousands = 2 - hundreds/9. No 19xx ReLU.
Months recognised from letters 2-3 only (bigram bump), with march's ambiguous 'ar' tagged weakly. Drops a letter dim; d_model 32.
Hyphen logit = 1000*(ONE - sum of digit-step flags): the hyphen needs no stream dim of its own.
Dropped the prompt/answer flag: only the two answer hyphens look like run ends, so the parser is gated by their steps K5, K8.
is-digit flags from 2 and 3 back merged into one counter ZS (year = Z1 + ZS == 3).
Letters embedded on a circle so each month is one ReLU matching two template angles: d_ff 42 -> 18.
Prompt position flags i==1 and i<=2 overlaid on output-step dims K1, K2 (prompt and answer never interfere). 29 stream dims used.
Answer step factored into field flag x digit flag; a head joins in only if its digit flag is on, via a louder '=' query. d_model 28.
No dedicated '=' marker or thousands flag: '=' is US=2 (loudest padding) and thousands is FY minus H, T, O. 27 stream dims used.
3 heads, d_model 27: the hundreds digit is computed autoregressively from the just-written thousands digit (18 - 9y) by one ReLU.
Same circuit as ptr_v15, stored sparsely: only nonzero weights are parameters, so n_params is the true circuit size, not d_model^2 zeros.
Gain sweep: look-back Gaussian sharpness lowered from 30 to 5 to find the margin of the position attention.
Gain sweep: look-back sharpness 10. At 5, neighbour leakage e^-5 breaks the narrow month templates; 10 should clear them.
Gain sweep: fetch sharpness lowered from 30 to 10 with look-back at 10.
Gain sweep: fetch sharpness 20. At 10, weak tags (score 5) lost e^-5 to each of ~25 padding tokens; 20 gives score 10.
Ablation of ptr_v20: remove the 'any run end is a day' default unit.
Ablation of ptr_v20: remove the 'three or more digits back is a YEAR' unit.
Ablation showed the year unit is only needed for yyyy.mm.dd (padding finds other years), so YEAR = dot with a digit 3 back. No digit-run counter.
Ablation of ptr_v21: remove the 'first slash ends the MONTH' unit.
Ablation of ptr_v21: remove the 'dot after a digit ends the MONTH' unit.
Ablation of ptr_v21: remove the weak 'padding after a digit' year/day unit.
Ablation of ptr_v21: remove the unit that clears the tens slot at i=1, where there is no token 2 back.
Ablation of ptr_v21: remove the autoregressive hundreds unit (18 - 9*thousands), so every hundreds digit reads as 0.
Circle holds only the 14 letters months actually use (others at the origin), tripling the template margin: threshold 1.95 vs nearest miss 1.90.
Retests look-back gain 5 (0.41 on the 26-letter circle) now that the month template margin is three times wider.
Look-back gain 7. At 5 month units fired but unsaturated, scaling fetched digits (8 became 5); e^-7 leakage should keep activation near 1.
Slash and dot share one signed separator dim (+1/-1), and look-back gain returns to the safer 10. 26 stream dims used.
Hyphen logit reduced from 1000 to 2: it only has to beat logit 1 of digit 0 at X=0, so the head needs no big constant.
Tens fix moved from a ReLU into attention: at i=1 the 2-back head gets a self bonus and reads the separator, whose digit value is 0. 18 ReLUs.
Control on ptr_v27: march's 'ar' tag made full strength, so 'ar' ties with 'an'/'eb' in january and february.
Look-back query is a rotation of a position circle (cos kernel) instead of a Gaussian in (1,i,i^2): 6 weights per head instead of 9.
W_v copies only the 7 look-back features that are read later, not all 12.
Position circle written only on prompt positions: answer tokens never read back, so their look-back attention can be uniform and unused.
The constant ONE is only written on answer steps, the only tokens whose query or logits use it.
The thousands step is recognised from its own '=' token (US=2) rather than as FY minus H, T, O: the fetch query needs fewer weights.
Hundreds gate shrunk from H*100 to H*20, the smallest round value that passes 18 - 9y.
Gain sweep: fetch sharpness 14, between the failing 10 and the passing 20.
Control: tangent logits without the +1, so digit 0 at X=0 ties with every non-digit logit at 0. Fetch gain back at 20.
First dot of yyyy.mm.dd found by position (flag O overlaid on i=4) instead of a digit 3 back, dropping the Z3 dim. 25 stream dims used.
Month threshold moved from 1.95 to 1.91, just above the nearest miss at 1.90: wider ReLU ramp, less sensitive to attention leakage.
Position circle shortened from 48 to 36 steps: only prompt tokens (i<=31) use it, so it need not cover answer positions, and G falls by almost half.
Weak padding tag raised from 0.5 to 0.75: more margin against padding tokens, less against the strong tags it must still lose to.
Third test of look-back gain 5 (0.41, then 0.605), now with the wider month ramp from ptr_v36. Weak tag back at 0.5.
Look-back gain back at 10; the circuit is checked on 100000 generated examples across five non-eval seeds before finalising.
Final circuit, verification scaffolding removed: 3 look-back heads, 18 ReLUs (6 parse rules, 12 month templates), 3 fetch heads, tangent digit head.
